investigations.name: dynamic-networks
investigations.title: Dynamic Networks — a catalog of network-reconfiguring rules
investigations.description: This investigation is a catalog: each study instantiates the same generalized process with a different registered reaction and shows the network evolving under that rule as an interactive animation and a GIF. Family A (studies 1–8) covers the dynamics OF networks — rules that rewire topology. A later Family B will add continuous multi-species dynamics ON the networks (an SBML simulator at each node via viva-copasi, with transport/diffusion along edges).
